dialogues.jp:
何ともはや、時代錯誤というか、場違いという
か、ハイブラウと言ったらいいのか。
dialogues.en:
Somehow, I managed to find something high-brow and horribly
out of place around here.
dialogues.text:
Somehow, I managed to find something high-brow and horribly
out of place around here.

dialogues.jp:
如何にも高価そうなドレスを着て、日傘を差し
た女の人──年齢は分からない──が居るのだ
が、何と、メイドさんを従えているのだ。
dialogues.en:
An expensively-clothed umbrella-carrying woman, accompanied
by a maid. Her age wasn't easy to tell.
dialogues.text:
An expensively-clothed umbrella-carrying woman, accompanied
by a maid. Her age wasn't easy to tell.

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど、結婚式でドレスの｛すそ／裾｝を持つ女の子の
ような感じで。しかも、二人。
dialogues.en:
The way she was dressed, you would think they were heading
for a wedding ceremony.
dialogues.text:
The way she was dressed, you would think they were heading
for a wedding ceremony.

dialogues.en: "I wonder where her aristocrat husband is..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder where her aristocrat husband is..."

dialogues.jp: 珍しくて、つい、じろじろと見てしまう。
dialogues.en: Interested in the weird sight, I kept staring.
dialogues.text: Interested in the weird sight, I kept staring.

dialogues.jp:
と、視線を感じたのか、日傘を上げ、女の人が
こちらに目を向けた。
dialogues.en:
Apparently noticing said interest, the woman raised her
umbrella, and looked directly at me.
dialogues.text:
Apparently noticing said interest, the woman raised her
umbrella, and looked directly at me.

dialogues.jp:
目があった途端、傘を下ろしてしまった。そし
て、そそくさと去っていく。驚いたようにメイ
ドが、その後を追った。
dialogues.en:
Just as our eyes met, she lowered her umbrella again, and
hurried away. Her maid chased worriedly after her.
dialogues.text:
Just as our eyes met, she lowered her umbrella again, and
hurried away. Her maid chased worriedly after her.

dialogues.jp:
遠めだからはっきりとは分からないが、俺と同
じくらいの年齢だったようだ。そして、腕には
猫を抱いていた。
dialogues.en:
She seemed to be my age, and had a cat in her arms... I
don't know why she walked off so quickly.
dialogues.text:
She seemed to be my age, and had a cat in her arms... I
don't know why she walked off so quickly.

dialogues.en: "Must be one of those pure princesses who never go outside."
dialogues.text: "Must be one of those pure princesses who never go outside."

dialogues.en: I've never seen someone like that around...
dialogues.text: I've never seen someone like that around...

dialogues.jp:
やけに高貴な格好をして、しかもメイドさん着き
という、何ともハイブラウな女性を目撃してしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I caught sight of a high-brow girl in expensive-looking
clothes, and being escorted by a maid.
dialogues.text:
I caught sight of a high-brow girl in expensive-looking
clothes, and being escorted by a maid.

dialogues.en: I've not seen something like that before...
dialogues.text: I've not seen something like that before...
